- name: int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics
      description: Account-level daily KPIs with rolling averages, efficiency metrics, 30-day trend deltas, scoring, maturity, and data-quality flags joined to most-recent account info
      grain: One row per account_id, source_relation, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history (filtered to is_most_recent_record = true)
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats as daily_stats (no filtering). - From staging.stg_google_ads__account_history, keep only rows where is_most_recent_record = true (account_info). - Compute rolling_metrics per (account_id, source_relation), ordered by date_day: - 7-day rolling averages: for each day, average spend, clicks, and impressions across the current day and up to six prior days; averages ignore NULLs and use smaller windows at the start. - 30-day lags: prior 30th-day values for spend and conversions for month-over-month comparisons. - Efficiency metrics (rounded to 4 decimals): - CTR: percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks; 0 when impressions <= 0. - CPC: spend per click; 0 when clicks <= 0. - CPM: spend per 1,000 impressions; 0 when impressions <= 0. - Cost per conversion: spend per conversion; NULL when conversions <= 0. - ROAS: conversion value divided by spend; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0. - Compute account_scoring: - days_since_first_activity: days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative. - performance_score: clamp to 0–100 for the sum of: CTR*10; ROAS*10 capped at 50; +20 if cost_per_conversion < 50; and either +10 if clicks_7d_avg > 100 else + (clicks_7d_avg / 10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL. - spend_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - conversions_mom_change_pct: percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions when the lag > 0; rounded to 2 decimals; else NULL. - account_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <30 → "New Account"; <90 → "Growing Account"; <365 → "Established Account"; else "Mature Account". - performance_tier by performance_score: ≥80 → "Excellent"; ≥60 → "Good"; ≥40 → "Average"; ≥20 → "Below Average"; else "Poor". - Final select joins account_scoring to account_info on (account_id, source_relation) with a left join; account_name, currency_code, and time_zone may be NULL if no match. - Apply final filters: keep rows where spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, date_day IS NOT NULL, and account_id IS NOT NULL. - Output is ordered by account_id, date_day (ordering does not affect computed values).'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier for the source dataset; used for window partitioning and joining to account_info
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Ads account ID; with source_relation and date_day defines the row grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from the most-recent history; NULL when no matching record
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: time_zone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account time zone from the most-recent history; may be NULL
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the daily metrics from stats; required for window ordering and lag calculations
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost in account currency; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: clicks
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions count; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; constrained to non-negative values
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value in account currency; used in ROAS; may be zero or NULL
      - name: ctr
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Percentage of impressions that resulted in clicks, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per click in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks <= 0
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per 1,000 impressions in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions <= 0
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Spend per conversion in account currency, rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions <= 0
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Conversion value divided by spend, rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0
      - name: spend_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of spend per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: clicks_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of clicks per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: impressions_7d_avg
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rolling 7-day average of impressions per (account_id, source_relation) ordered by date_day; uses up to 7 days and ignores NULLs
      - name: spend_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of spend, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: conversions_mom_change_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change vs the 30-day lag of conversions, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the lag is NULL or <= 0
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the earliest date_day for the account_id (partitioned by account_id only); non-negative
      - name: account_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on days_since_first_activity: <30 New; <90 Growing; <365 Established; else Mature'
      - name: performance_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite score clamped to 0–100 from CTR (x10), ROAS (x10 capped at 50), cost-per-conversion bonus (20 if <50), and clicks_7d_avg bonus (10 if >100 else clicks_7d_avg/10); may be NULL if clicks_7d_avg is NULL
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by performance_score: ≥80 Excellent; ≥60 Good; ≥40 Average; ≥20 Below Average; else Poor'
      - name: has_spend_no_clicks_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when spend > 0 and clicks = 0; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: invalid_metrics_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when clicks exceed impressions; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: high_spend_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when daily spend > 10000; else false
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis
      description: Daily Google Ads campaign cohort and lifecycle analysis with cumulative metrics, cohort benchmarks, ranks, and quality flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, campaign_id, and date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - Use the most recent campaign_history records (is_most_recent_record = true) providing campaign_id, source_relation, campaign_name, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, status, start_date, end_date. - Use all rows from campaign_stats providing campaign_id, source_relation, date_day, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value. - Join and row set: - Join stats to latest history on campaign_id and source_relation; keep only matched rows (effective inner join). - Grain is per source_relation, campaign_id, and date_day from stats with a matching history record. - Cohort and lifecycle: - campaign_launch_cohort is the first day of the month of start_date; NULL if start_date is missing. - days_since_launch is the whole-day difference between start_date and date_day; may be negative; NULL if start_date is missing. - lifecycle_stage is bucketed by days_since_launch: <=7 Launch Phase; <=30 Optimization Phase; <=90 Growth Phase; <=365 Maturity Phase; otherwise Legacy Phase. When days_since_launch is NULL, assign Legacy Phase. - Daily performance metrics: - spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value are taken as-is from stats. - ctr is 100 * clicks / impressions rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when impressions = 0. - cpc is spend / clicks rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks = 0. - cost_per_conversion is spend / conversions rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions = 0. - roas is conversions_value / spend rounded to 4 decimals when both spend and conversions_value are > 0; otherwise 0. - Cumulative metrics: - For each campaign_id and source_relation, ordered by date_day ascending, compute running totals for spend, clicks, conversions, and conversions_value including the current day; NULL inputs are ignored in the sums. - Cohort benchmarks and ranks: - cohort averages (spend, ctr, roas) are computed across all rows sharing the same campaign_launch_cohort and lifecycle_stage, including the current row; NULLs are ignored. - roas_rank_in_cohort is the position of a row when ROAS is sorted high to low within its cohort-stage; 1 is highest; ties are resolved arbitrarily; rows without ROAS are placed after those with ROAS. - total_campaigns_in_cohort_stage is the count of rows within the same cohort-stage, including the current row. - Performance vs cohort (percent deltas): - spend_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_spend rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_spend is not positive. - ctr_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_ctr rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_ctr is not positive. - roas_vs_cohort_pct is the percent difference from cohort_avg_roas rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when cohort_avg_roas is not positive. - Composite indicators: - campaign_health_score combines: CTR contributes 5× its value; ROAS contributes 20× its value capped at 60; cost_per_conversion contributes 20 if below 100, otherwise decreases linearly and does not go below 0; cumulative_conversions contributes 20 if at least 10, otherwise 2 points per conversion. The sum is bounded between 0 and 100. If cost_per_conversion is missing, the score is NULL. - performance_tier_in_cohort is assigned by ROAS rank thresholds within cohort-stage: Top 20% if rank is within the top 20% of rows (rounded up), Top 50% if within 50%, Bottom 50% if within 80%, else Bottom 20%. - investment_tier by cumulative_spend: <1000 Low Investment; <5000 Medium Investment; <20000 High Investment; otherwise Premium Investment. - momentum_indicator: High Momentum in Launch/Optimization when ROAS exceeds the cohort average; High Momentum in Growth/Maturity when ROAS is at least 20% above the cohort average; Low Momentum when ROAS is at least 20% below the cohort average; otherwise Stable Momentum. - Quality flags: - data_quality_issue is true when clicks > impressions. - underperforming_flag is true when spend > 0, conversions = 0, and days_since_launch > 30; NULL days_since_launch evaluates to false. - exceptional_performance_flag is true when roas > 10. - Final row filter and ordering: - Keep only rows with spend, clicks, impressions, and conversions all >= 0, and with non-null date_day and campaign_id. - Output is ordered by campaign_id then date_day; ordering does not change computed values.'

      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source identifier used in the join and window partitions
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Ads campaign ID; join and grouping key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign name from the most recent history record
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel type from campaign history
      - name: advertising_channel_subtype
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Advertising channel subtype from campaign history
      - name: campaign_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign status from the most recent history record

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation
      description: Daily keyword performance with campaign benchmarks, segmentation tiers, bid recommendations, and quality/optimization flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id, date_day
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      business_logic: '- Load all rows from staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats (ks). - Join dimensional data: - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history (agi) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on ad_group_id and source_relation. - Join to staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history (ci) filtered to is_most_recent_record = true on campaign_id and source_relation. - Compute per-row performance metrics (rounding to 4 decimals unless noted; NULL policies explicit): - ctr: if impressions > 0 → (clicks / impressions) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - cpc: if clicks > 0 → spend / clicks; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cpm: if impressions > 0 → spend / impressions * 1000; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - cost_per_conversion: if conversions > 0 → spend / conversions; else NULL; rounded 4 decimals. - roas: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 → conversions_value / spend; else 0; rounded 4 decimals. - conversion_rate: if clicks > 0 → (conversions / clicks) * 100; else 0; rounded 4 decimals; unit = percentage (0+). - Compute lifetime cumulative metrics using window sums partitioned by (keyword_id = ks.criterion_id, ad_group_id) ordered by date_day, rows unbounded preceding: - lifetime_spend, lifetime_clicks, lifetime_conversions, lifetime_conversions_value. - Compute days_since_first_activity: number of days between the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition and the current date_day; non-negative integer. - Compute campaign-level benchmarks over (partition by campaign_id, date_day): - campaign_avg_ctr, campaign_avg_cpc, campaign_avg_conversion_rate, campaign_avg_roas (simple averages of per-row metrics). - Percentile ranks: ctr_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by ctr ascending; conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by conversion_rate ascending; roas_percentile_in_campaign = percent_rank ordered by roas descending; range [0,1]. - Derive segmentation and recommendations: - ctr_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 → ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr) / campaign_avg_ctr) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - roas_vs_campaign_pct: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 → ((roas - campaign_avg_roas) / campaign_avg_roas) * 100; else NULL; rounded 2 decimals. - keyword_maturity_stage by days_since_first_activity: <7 → "New Keyword"; <30 → "Testing Phase"; <90 → "Optimization Phase"; <365 → "Mature Keyword"; else "Legacy Keyword". - performance_tier based on percentiles (evaluated in listed order; first match wins): ctr_pct >= 0.8 and conv_pct >= 0.8 → "Star Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.6 and conv_pct >= 0.6 → "Strong Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.4 and conv_pct >= 0.4 → "Average Performer"; ctr_pct >= 0.2 or conv_pct >= 0.2 → "Weak Performer"; else "Poor Performer". - bid_recommendation: roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr*1.2 → "Increase Bid (+20%)"; roas > campaign_avg_roas*1.2 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr → "Increase Bid (+10%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.7 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr*0.8 → "Decrease Bid (-20%)"; roas < campaign_avg_roas*0.8 and ctr < campaign_avg_ctr → "Decrease Bid (-10%)"; conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 30 → "Consider Pausing"; else "Maintain Bid". - efficiency_score: treat any missing percentile as 0, weight (ctr 30, conv_rate 40, roas 30), clamp to [0,100]; final output rounded to 1 decimal. - volume_tier by lifetime_spend: <100 → "Low Volume"; <1000 → "Medium Volume"; <5000 → "High Volume"; else "Premium Volume". - value_tier by lifetime_conversions_value: <500 → "Low Value"; <2500 → "Medium Value"; <10000 → "High Value"; else "Premium Value". - Derive quality/ops flags (always non-NULL booleans): - data_quality_flag: clicks > impressions. - optimization_needed_flag: spend > 100 and conversions = 0 and days_since_first_activity > 14. - scale_opportunity_flag: roas > 5 and ctr > campaign_avg_ctr * 1.5. - pause_candidate_flag: efficiency_score < 20 and days_since_first_activity > 30. - Final filter (rows must satisfy): spend >= 0, clicks >= 0, impressions >= 0, conversions >= 0, and date_day, keyword_id, ad_group_id, campaign_id are NOT NULL. - Output rows are ordered by keyword_id, ad_group_id, date_day; no de-duplication beyond the final filter.'

      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system relation identifier used for dimensional joins and lineage
      - name: keyword_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword criterion_id from keyword_stats; grouping key for lifetime windows and grain
        tests:
        - not_null

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier; part of grain and lifetime window partition
        tests:
        - not_null

        - not_null

      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent campaign name from campaign_history; may be NULL if no match
      - name: advertising_channel_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign advertising channel type from campaign_history; values as stored by source

        data_type: DATE
        description: Activity date; part of grain and window ordering
        tests:
        - not_null

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily cost for the keyword; non-negative per final filter; used in CPC/CPM/ROAS calculations
        tests:
        - spend >= 0

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily clicks; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPC/conversion_rate calculations
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily impressions; non-negative per final filter; used in CTR/CPM calculations
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversions; non-negative per final filter; used in cost_per_conversion and conversion_rate
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Daily conversion value; used in ROAS; if spend <= 0 or conversions_value <= 0 then ROAS = 0

        description: 'Click-through rate in percentage: if impressions > 0 then (clicks/impressions)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals; not capped'
      - name: cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per click: if clicks > 0 then spend/clicks else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cpm
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per thousand impressions: if impressions > 0 then spend/impressions*1000 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: cost_per_conversion
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Cost per conversion: if conversions > 0 then spend/conversions else NULL; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Return on ad spend: if spend > 0 and conversions_value > 0 then conversions_value/spend else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Conversion rate in percentage: if clicks > 0 then (conversions/clicks)*100 else 0; rounded to 4 decimals'
      - name: lifetime_spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative spend up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cumulative clicks up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversions up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: lifetime_conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Cumulative conversion value up to date_day over partition (keyword_id, ad_group_id); window ordered by date_day
      - name: days_since_first_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: 'Days since first activity: current date_day minus the first date in the (keyword_id, ad_group_id) partition; non-negative'
      - name: campaign_avg_ctr
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) across keywords; unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row CTR
      - name: campaign_avg_cpc
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average CPC within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row CPC
      - name: campaign_avg_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average conversion rate within (campaign_id, date_day); unit = percentage; simple mean of per-row rate
      - name: campaign_avg_roas
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day); simple mean of per-row ROAS
      - name: ctr_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'CTR vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_ctr > 0 then ((ctr - campaign_avg_ctr)/campaign_avg_ctr)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: roas_vs_campaign_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'ROAS vs campaign average: if campaign_avg_roas > 0 then ((roas - campaign_avg_roas)/campaign_avg_roas)*100 rounded to 2 decimals else NULL'
      - name: ctr_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of CTR within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - ctr_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of conversion_rate within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered ascending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - conv_rate_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: roas_percentile_in_campaign
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent_rank of ROAS within (campaign_id, date_day) ordered descending; range [0,1]
        tests:
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign >= 0
        - roas_percentile_in_campaign <= 1
      - name: keyword_maturity_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage derived from days_since_first_activity: New Keyword, Testing Phase, Optimization Phase, Mature Keyword, Legacy Keyword'
        tests:
        - keyword_maturity_stage IN ('New Keyword','Testing Phase','Optimization Phase','Mature Keyword','Legacy Keyword')
      - name: performance_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on CTR and conversion rate percentiles: Star/Strong/Average/Weak/Poor Performer'

- name: google_ads__channel_performance_analysis
      description: Daily performance by channel, subtype, network, and device with aggregates, efficiency metrics, benchmarks, portfolio analytics, classifications, and alerts.
      grain: One row per source_relation + date_day + advertising_channel_type + advertising_channel_subtype + ad_network_type + device (filtered to total_spend > 0, date_day not null, advertising_channel_type not null)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats
      business_logic: '- Inputs: - campaign_performance (cp): intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis - account_stats (ast): staging.stg_google_ads__account_stats - Join: - Left join ast to cp on campaign_id (cast to varchar) = account_id, with matching source_relation and date_day. - ad_network_type and device come from ast and can be NULL when no match exists. - Aggregation (channel_device_performance): - Group by source_relation, date_day, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, ad_network_type, device. - Sums: spend → total_spend; clicks → total_clicks; impressions → total_impressions; conversions → total_conversions; conversions_value → total_conversions_value. - Distinct counts of campaigns: active_campaigns; conditional counts for lifecycle stages (Launch Phase, Growth Phase), momentum (High Momentum), performance tiers (Top 20%, Bottom 20%), and underperforming_flag = true. - Investment sums: premium_spend for investment_tier = Premium Investment; high_investment_spend for investment_tier = High Investment. - Averages: avg_campaign_health_score from campaign_health_score; avg_roas from roas. - Efficiency and benchmarks (efficiency_analysis): - CTR (%): clicks divided by impressions, expressed as percent; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - CPC: spend divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when clicks are 0. - CPM: spend per thousand impressions; rounded to 4 decimals; set to 0 when impressions are 0. - Cost per conversion (CPA): spend divided by conversions; rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when conversions are 0. - ROAS: conversions_value divided by spend; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0. - Conversion rate (%): conversions divided by clicks; rounded to 4 decimals; 0 when clicks are 0. - Daily share metrics by date_day: each group''s spend, clicks, and conversions divided by the total for that date, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals; zero totals are treated as missing to avoid division by zero. - Channel benchmarks by date_day: - channel_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - channel_benchmark_roas: average ROAS within the same advertising_channel_type; uses 0 when spend or conversions_value is 0; not rounded. - Device benchmarks by date_day: - device_benchmark_ctr: average CTR percent within the same device; uses 0 when impressions are 0; not rounded. - device_benchmark_cpa: average CPA within the same device using only rows with conversions; NULLs are ignored; not rounded. - Performance insights: - Deltas vs benchmarks (rounded to 2 decimals; NULL when the benchmark is <= 0): - ctr_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, roas_vs_channel_benchmark_pct, ctr_vs_device_benchmark_pct, cpa_vs_device_benchmark_pct (CPA delta is also NULL when cost_per_conversion is NULL). - Channel investment tier by total_spend: <500 → Emerging Channel; <2000 → Developing Channel; <10000 → Established Channel; otherwise Major Channel. - Performance classification (first match applies): - Star Channel: ROAS ≥ 3.0, CTR ≥ channel benchmark, and spend_share_pct ≥ 5. - Strong Channel: ROAS ≥ 2.0 and CTR ≥ 80% of channel benchmark. - Stable Channel: ROAS ≥ 1.0 and CTR ≥ 60% of channel benchmark. - Developing Channel: ROAS ≥ 0.5. - Otherwise: Optimization Needed. - Portfolio percentages (%): high_momentum_pct, top_tier_pct, underperforming_pct each computed as count divided by active_campaigns, expressed as percent and rounded to 1 decimal; set to 0 when active_campaigns is 0. - Channel efficiency score (0–100): weighted blend of CTR delta (30%), ROAS delta (40%), and avg_campaign_health_score (30%); missing inputs default to 50; the score is capped between 0 and 100. - Final processing: - premium_spend_pct: premium_spend divided by total_spend, expressed as percent and rounded to 2 decimals. - Rounding: avg_campaign_health_score to 1 decimal; avg_roas to 4 decimals; channel_efficiency_score to 1 decimal. - Alerts: roi_alert when ROAS < 0.5 and total_spend > 1000; portfolio_health_alert when underperforming_pct > 50; strategic_review_needed when spend_share_pct > 30 and performance_classification is Optimization Needed; growth_opportunity when high_momentum_pct > 50 and channel_efficiency_score > 80. - Filter rows: keep only total_spend > 0, date_day not null, and advertising_channel_type not null; sort by date_day descending, then total_spend descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__customer_acquisition_analysis
      description: Customer acquisition analysis by account and date with matched campaign context, cohort-based CAC/LTV, running totals, cohort benchmarks, segmentation, recommendations, and alert flags
      grain: One row per source_relation, account_id, date_day, and matched campaign cohort row (joined on source_relation, account_id=campaign_id, and date_day); if no match, one row with NULL campaign fields
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__account_performance_metrics (source_relation, account_id, account_name, date_day, account_maturity_stage, spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, ctr, cpc, cost_per_conversion, roas)
      - intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis (source_relation, campaign_id, date_day, advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, lifecycle_stage)
      business_logic: '- Begin with account_performance (ap); left join campaign_cohorts (cc) on source_relation, account_id=campaign_id, and date_day. - Keep only ap rows where conversions > 0 or spend > 0. - Acquisition cohort: for each account_id, find the earliest date_day with conversions > 0 and use the first day of that month; set to NULL if the account has no conversions. - Days since first conversion: calendar days between the account’s first conversion date and the current date_day; NULL if no first conversion date. - Channel and lifecycle: take advertising_channel_type, advertising_channel_subtype, and lifecycle_stage (as campaign_lifecycle_stage) from cc; these may be NULL. - Running totals within each account_id ordered by date_day from earliest to current: - cumulative_acquisition_cost: running sum of spend. - cumulative_conversions: running sum of conversions. - cumulative_ltv: running sum of conversions_value. - If multiple rows share the same date_day, accumulation follows the row order. - Daily portfolio counts per account_id and date_day (based on joined cc rows; NULLs ignored): - active_campaigns_count: distinct campaign_id count. - channel_diversity_count: distinct advertising_channel_type count. - Derived economics per row: - customer_acquisition_cost (CAC): cumulative_acquisition_cost divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise NULL. - average_customer_ltv: cumulative_ltv divided by cumulative_conversions, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - ltv_cac_ratio: average_customer_ltv divided by customer_acquisition_cost, rounded to 2 decimals when cumulative_acquisition_cost > 0 and cumulative_conversions > 0; otherwise 0. - estimated_payback_days: cost_per_conversion divided by average conversion value on the row (conversions_value divided by conversions), scaled to 30 days and rounded to a whole number when cost_per_conversion > 0 and conversions_value > 0; otherwise NULL. - Cohort benchmarks: - cohort_avg_cac: average of (cumulative_acquisition_cost / cumulative_conversions) across rows sharing acquisition_cohort and advertising_channel_type; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - cohort_avg_ltv: average of (cumulative_ltv / cumulative_conversions) across the same cohort/channel; rows with cumulative_conversions <= 0 are excluded; not rounded. - Percentile ranks within acquisition_cohort: - cac_efficiency_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on customer_acquisition_cost with lower values ranked higher. - ltv_cac_performance_percentile: percentile (0–1) based on ltv_cac_ratio with higher values ranked higher. - Segmentation and insights: - acquisition_efficiency_tier by ltv_cac_ratio: ≥3.0 Excellent; ≥2.0 Good; ≥1.0 Break-even; ≥0.5 Negative; else Poor. - cac_performance_tier by cac_efficiency_percentile: ≥0.8 Top CAC Efficiency; ≥0.6 Above Average CAC; ≥0.4 Average CAC; ≥0.2 Below Average CAC; else High CAC. - customer_maturity_stage from days_since_first_conversion: Not Acquired (NULL), ≤30 New Customer, ≤90 Early Stage, ≤365 Developing Customer, ≤1095 Mature Customer, else Long-term Customer. - acquisition_sophistication_score: clamp to [0,100] of (channel_diversity_count*15 + active_campaigns_count*5 + up to 30 from average_customer_ltv, and up to 25 from ltv_cac_ratio); Also carry: source_relation, account_id, account_name, currency_code, date_day, account_maturity_stage, performance_score, performance_tier, spend_mom_change_pct, conversions_mom_change_pct. 2) Build campaign_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__campaign_cohort_analysis: active_campaigns=count of distinct campaigns; campaigns_in_launch/growth/maturity=count of distinct campaigns in each lifecycle stage; high_momentum_campaigns=count with momentum_indicator=''High Momentum''; underperforming_campaigns=count with underperforming_flag=true; premium_investment_campaigns=count with investment_tier=''Premium Investment''; premium_investment_spend=sum of spend for ''Premium Investment''. Null campaign/category values are not counted; missing dates yield no records. 3) Build keyword_aggregates by date_day (global scope) from intermediate.int_google_ads__keyword_performance_segmentation: active_keywords=count of distinct keywords; star_performer_keywords=count with performance_tier=''Star Performer''; bid_increase_opportunities=count where bid_recommendation starts with ''Increase''; pause_candidate_keywords=count with pause_candidate_flag=true; avg_keyword_efficiency_score=average efficiency_score. Missing dates yield no records. 4) Join account-level metrics to campaign_aggregates and keyword_aggregates on date_day; replace missing aggregate counts and premium_investment_spend with 0; set avg_keyword_efficiency_score to 0 when missing. 5) Compute trends per account_id ordered by date_day: - spend_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_spend vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - conversions_wow_growth_pct: percent change in total_conversions vs the value 7 days prior; round to 2 decimals; set to null if the prior value is missing or <= 0. - spend_30d_avg: rolling average of total_spend over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 2 decimals. - roas_30d_avg: rolling average of overall_roas over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 4 decimals. - performance_score_30d_avg: rolling average of performance_score over the current day and the 29 preceding rows for the same account; rounded in final to 1 decimal. Window partition: by account_id; order: date_day ascending. 6) Derive classifications and flags: - premium_investment_pct: premium_investment_spend/total_spend*100; round to 2 decimals; if total_spend=0 then null (rows with 0 spend are excluded by filter). - performance_alert (first match wins): spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''High Spend Growth Alert''; spend_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Spend Decline Alert''; conversions_wow_growth_pct > 50 → ''Conversion Growth Opportunity''; conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30 → ''Conversion Decline Alert''; overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000 → ''ROI Optimization Needed''; underperforming_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Health Issue''; else ''Normal Performance''. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 and bid_increase_opportunities > 10 using safe divide → ''Scale High Performers''; pause_candidate_keywords/active_keywords > 0.2 using safe divide → ''Portfolio Optimization Needed''; high_momentum_campaigns/active_campaigns > 0.3 using safe divide → ''Invest in Growth''; avg_keyword_efficiency_score < 40 → ''Keyword Strategy Review''; premium_investment_spend/total_spend < 0.1 using safe divide → ''Consider Premium Investments''; else ''Maintain Current Strategy''. - budget_efficiency_tier: ''Highly Efficient'' if overall_roas >= 4.0; ''Efficient'' if >= 2.0; ''Break-even'' if >= 1.0; ''Underperforming'' if >= 0.5; else ''Poor Performance''. - overall_account_health_score: cap to [0,100] after combining performance_score*0.6 and avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4; treat missing inputs as 0. - immediate_attention_required: true if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000; else false. - trending_alert: true if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30; else false. - scale_opportunity: true if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 using safe divide; else false. - top_performer_account: true if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80; else false. 7) Filter to executive-relevant rows: total_spend > 0, account_id present, date_day present. Order by account_id ascending and date_day descending.'

        description: Global count of distinct keywords with performance_tier='Star Performer' on date_day; COALESCE to 0
      - name: bid_increase_opportunities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global count of distinct keywords with bid_recommendation starting with 'Increase' on date_day; COALESCE to 0

      - name: roas_30d_avg

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Budget efficiency classification: Highly Efficient, Efficient, Break-even, Underperforming, or Poor Performance'

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite health score capped to [0,100] = performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 with bounding via least/greatest
      - name: immediate_attention_required
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if overall_roas < 1.0 and total_spend > 1000, else false
        tests:

      - name: trending_alert
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if spend_wow_growth_pct > 50 or conversions_wow_growth_pct < -30, else false
        tests:

      - name: scale_opportunity
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if star_performer_keywords/active_keywords > 0.15 (safe-divide), else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: top_performer_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if performance_score*0.6 + avg_keyword_efficiency_score*0.4 >= 80, else false
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: google_ads__keyword_report
      description: Daily keyword performance aggregated and enriched with most-recent account, campaign, ad group, and keyword attributes
      grain: One row per unique combination of source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, criterion_id, type, status, keyword_match_type, keyword_text
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats
      - staging.stg_google_ads__account_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__campaign_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_history
      - staging.stg_google_ads__ad_group_criterion_history
      business_logic: '- Load stats from staging.stg_google_ads__keyword_stats (no filters). - Restrict each history table to is_most_recent_record = true to represent current attributes. - Left join stats to: - criterions on (criterion_id, source_relation), - ad_groups on (ad_group_id, source_relation), - campaigns on (campaign_id, source_relation), - accounts on (account_id, source_relation). - Group by the 14 attribute columns: source_relation, date_day, account_name, account_id, currency_code, campaign_name, campaign_id, ad_group_name, ad_group_id, criterion_id, type, status, keyword_match_type, keyword_text. - Aggregate metrics with SUM: spend, clicks, impressions, conversions, conversions_value, view_through_conversions. Determinism: - SUM ignores NULL inputs; if all inputs in a group are NULL the result is NULL. - If a history table has multiple most-recent rows for the same id and source_relation, joins will duplicate stats rows and sums will inflate accordingly. - Attributes (names, status, match type, text, currency) come from the most recent history records; if a join does not find a match, those attributes are NULL but the stats group remains. - No ordering is applied in the final output; one row is returned per grouped attribute set with summed metrics; original casing and spacing are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source relation identifier used to disambiguate IDs across sources
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Statistical date for the keyword performance (UTC day)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent account name from account_history joined by account_id and source_relation; NULL if no match
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from stats used to join to the most-recent account record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: currency_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account currency code from the most-recent account record; NULL if no match
      - name: campaign_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent campaign name from campaign_history joined by campaign_id and source_relation; NULL if no match
      - name: campaign_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Campaign identifier from stats used to join to the most-recent campaign record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: ad_group_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent ad group name from ad_group_history joined by ad_group_id and source_relation; NULL if no match
      - name: ad_group_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Ad group identifier from stats used to join to the most-recent ad group record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: criterion_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Keyword criterion identifier from stats used to join to the most-recent criterion record
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent criterion type from ad_group_criterion_history; NULL if no match
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent keyword status from ad_group_criterion_history; NULL if no match
      - name: keyword_match_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent keyword match type from ad_group_criterion_history; NULL if no match
      - name: keyword_text
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most-recent keyword text from ad_group_criterion_history; original casing and spacing; NULL if no match
      - name: spend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of spend for the group in account currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - spend >= 0
      - name: clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of clicks for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - clicks >= 0
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - impressions >= 0
      - name: conversions
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversions for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - conversions >= 0
      - name: conversions_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of conversion value for the group in account currency; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - conversions_value >= 0
      - name: view_through_conversions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of view-through conversions for the group; NULL if all inputs are NULL
        tests:
        - view_through_conversions >= 0
